metadata.scope: Original conceptual visual-appearance recipes. No executable shader assets, measured property datasets or engineering qualifications are supplied.
metadata.legacy_id_policy: MAT-001 through MAT-200 retain their original semantic identities; MAT-201 through MAT-600 extend the catalog.
metadata.coordinate_policy: Scene lengths in mm, angles in radians, Z-up. Optical-entry units must be explicitly converted to scene units.
metadata.engineering_policy: Visual appearance remains separate from engineering composition, density, strength, thermal properties, friction, electrical performance and qualification.
metadata.lunar_policy: Lunar surfaces and deposits are granular or geometric concepts in vacuum; no terrestrial airborne fog is encoded.
metadata.authoring_policy: Original English descriptions and deterministic procedural authoring proposals; no commercial material library, proprietary CAD extraction or third-party artwork is included.
